# Public tariff evidence

These decoded Product JSON-LD objects were supplied inline from the parent's existing
public research capture. No private API key, request record or user identifier is included.
The parent supplied provenance.json unchanged; its hashes identify the original HTML,
not the serialized JSON fixture files in this directory. The raw HTML archive could not
be materialized in this executor, so those original HTML hashes were not independently
verified here. Tests verify decoded schema acceptance, not live network access or a
supplier wallet debit. Unicode escape spelling and whitespace may differ after inline
transfer; decoded JSON values are preserved. Production never imports these fixtures.
